## Services
- WordPress development: custom plugins, custom themes, Gutenberg blocks, WooCommerce, Elementor, ACF
- SEO: technical and on-page SEO, keyword research, audits, Core Web Vitals, schema markup (Ahrefs, Semrush, Rank Math, Yoast, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, GA4)
- Website speed: WP Rocket, NitroPack, LiteSpeed Cache
- Next.js and React websites and web apps
- PHP backends and APIs; Python and FastAPI
- Flutter apps for Android and iOS
